payload.packager_hypothesis: The loop is stuck because neither leftover finding can be closed by the fixer inside the spec. Both went past the fixer cap in r1 and were never fixed, disputed or overruled. AC-17-19's "checkCriterionCoupling is not defined" failure sits in substrate/test/graph-lint-helpers.js. The spec excludes that file as the Test Author's surface, so the bug is in the test loader, not in build-spec.js. The repeated AC-13 finding (medium, correctness, still open) comes from ambiguous spec wording. AC-13 lists "wait" as a kind of repair attempt, but its outcome enum has no value for a wait on its own. That leaves open whether a wait that leads to a rerun should add its own boundary_repairs entry. It also matches the fact that the only pushes happen on rerun and escalate. Both lenses in the r2c confirmation round were silent on these two findings, and silence is not evidence that they are resolved.
